hero.title: Take control of your YouTube playlists
hero.subtitle: Reorder, copy, organize, and build playlists with a simple drag-and-drop experience.

landing.permission: PlayPick only requests the YouTube permissions required to manage your playlists.

dashboard.heading: What would you like to do?
dashboard.subtitle: Pick a tool to start organizing your playlists.

reorder.title: Reorder Playlist
reorder.description: Rearrange videos in one of your existing playlists using drag and drop.

copy.title: Copy Between Playlists
copy.description: Copy videos from one playlist to another without removing them from the original playlist.

create.title: Create Playlist
create.description: Create a new YouTube playlist and start adding videos to it.

build.title: Build Playlist
build.description: Choose videos from your existing playlists and combine them into a new playlist.

merge.title: Merge Playlists
merge.description: Combine videos from multiple playlists into a single playlist.

duplicate.title: Duplicate Playlist
duplicate.description: Create a copy of an existing playlist.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist.
